correctness.rationale: Takahashi’s finite-frame reduction gives an exact first-order definition of the finite validating frames; Fagin’s zero-one law then applies, and the Le Bars instance follows because K plus one axiom has exactly that axiom’s validating frames.

originality.rationale: Checked literature did not state the combination. Takahashi stops at polynomial-time validity, while the Le Bars and Goranko zero-one counterexamples predate the 2026 finite-frame reduction.

value.rationale: The criterion gives an unconditional, reusable obstruction to elementarity and immediately converts a known nonconvergent modal frame-validity sequence into a finitely axiomatized non-elementary logic.
